basis: Endocrine gland neoplasia defines this umbrella; additional organ sites vary by subtype.
Congenital narrowing of the pulmonary heart valve; this is a cardiovascular malformation.
Definition specifies urate urinary stones; stone composition alone does not establish a systemic metabolic disorder.
Autosomal dominant nonsyndromic sensorineural hearing loss.
Renal, hepatic and pancreatic dysplasia define the triad; intrinsic pancreatic endocrine failure occurs in 30-79%. Pulmonary hypoplasia and cardiac defects occur in <30%.
Isolated familial dilated cardiomyopathy directly impairs myocardium; heart failure and arrhythmias remain within the same axis.
Isolated male infertility with globozoospermia affects reproductive function; no endocrine dysfunction is established.
Defined by brain malformations, axon defects and/or congenital ocular motility impairment. Endocrine abnormalities and contractures vary; ≥30% involvement is not established.
Isolated congenital lacrimal apparatus dysfunction causes absent tears and corneal epithelial injury.
Inborn lysine metabolism disorder caused by defective mitochondrial transport; intellectual disability is reported, but ≥30% attributable neurologic involvement is not established.
